description: Codex imagegen candidates and deterministic runtime compilation for biome-scoped enemy identities.

sourceAtlasLayout.frameOrder: top row left-to-right, then bottom row left-to-right

promptContract.identityAuthority: Image 1 is the canonical enemy portrait and controls recognizable identity, anatomy cues, coloration, markings, costume, and equipment.
promptContract.styleAuthority: Image 2 controls rendering style only and must not replace the enemy identity.
promptContract.poseRequirement: Each atlas must redraw the creature's anatomy, limbs, appendages, equipment, surface motion, and silhouette for the requested action; rigid translation, rotation, skew, tint, or scale does not count as animation.
invariants: one enemy identity in every frame
consistent anatomy, appendage count, equipment count, palette, proportions, and pixel density
no labels, text, watermark, scenery, floor, cast shadow, or grid borders

qualityGates.semanticApproval: Human review is required for identity fidelity, anatomy, appendage and equipment continuity, action readability, final death pose, and matte edges.
